versions.content: If the function DoIP_TpTransmit or DoIP_IfTransmit is called and the data package is allowed to be sent according to the current DoIP protocol related information, the DoIP module shall return E_OK. 1.) If the connection to the SoAd is idle, the DoIP shall call the SoAd_TpTransmit func tion according to SWS_DoIP_00284 . 2.) If the connection to the SoAd is not idle, the DoIP shall store the transmission request and call SoAd_TpTransmit according to SWS_DoIP_00 284 as soon as the connection is idle again.
